newsitem.title: USA: Centennial Tech gets $44 mln in Q2 orders.
newsitem.headline: Centennial Tech gets $44 mln in Q2 orders.

text.p: Centennial Technologies Inc said Monday it received orders of about $44 million in the second quarter ended December 31, up from $14 million a year earlier.
The company did not say how the orders would affect its revenues or earnings for the quarter. Officials from the company were not available for comment.

The company, which makes PC card-based solutions and provides contract manufacturing services to original equipment manufacturers, said it had orders of about $37 million in its first quarter, ended September 30.
